sections.Profile:
Foxy Lady , released by Game Plan Inc. in 1978, is a cocktail-style pinball machine designed by Ed Cebula and Wendell McAdams, with artwork by Paul Loreli. This solid-state machine, part of the company's MPU-1 generation, features two flippers, two pop bumpers, and a unique playfield layout with rollover buttons, kick-out holes, and spinning targets.

- Manufacturer: Game Plan Inc.
- Years made: 1978
